quarterly_data.quarter: AstraZeneca press release: Ultomiris received accelerated approval in the US as first (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease's Ultomiris (ravulizumab) received US accelerated approval to reduce proteinuria in adults with primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN) at risk of disease progression - the first and only C5 complement inhibitor for this use (company claim) - based on a prespecified interim analysis of the I CAN Phase III trial in which Ultomiris showed a 43.4% reduction in proteinuria vs placebo at 34 weeks.
quarterly_data.figure: 43.4% reduction in proteinuria vs placebo at 34 weeks
